suite: V7 app action/state guards in Node VM
scope: Minimal DOM and fake Audio; real app.js, core.js and data.js are evaluated. No browser rendering, service worker, real audio, GPS, provider or live AI verified.

results.name: finishing before arrival and double-finishing cannot advance an unconfirmed next stop
arrival and manual playback context never complete a stop by themselves
skip confirmation is consumed once and cannot skip the next stop on a repeat event
+15 is a preview; discard leaves accepted duration/revision/progress unchanged
explicit +15 Apply changes only confirmed current duration and bumps one plan revision
explicit current +15 keeps a must-visit locked instead of silently unlocking it
pending +15 survives manual future edits and one explicit Apply
pending +15 survives Adjust remaining without allowing AI to change past/current identity
pending +15 cannot become +30 through an invalid proposal mutation
stale pending extension cannot overwrite a newer accepted plan
manual stale-revision review rejects overwrite after the editor opened
AI stale-revision protection uses the snapshot at Adjust entry, not late review creation
progress advancing while a manual preview waits makes that preview stale
forged disabled actions cannot remove, move or resize fixed prefix or locked future stop
adjust checkboxes cannot silently unlock an existing must-visit
manual future unlock requires confirmation and authorises only that draft removal
no-op manual review does not create a review or increment revision
header Back prompts for dirty editor and discard preserves the saved plan
Back from Add stop returns to the same unsaved draft without discard
unvisited unavailable current stop has an explicit replacement preview and safe apply
replacement of locked unavailable current stop requires explicit unlock consent
confirmed current stop cannot be replaced; only future editing is offered
arrival after replacement preview makes the replacement stale
resuming a paused tour requires confirmation before pausing another active tour
no reviewed mutation may change an earlier visited prefix even if the draft is corrupted
completed journeys cannot resume or be edited in place
new/adapted proposal selection cannot reuse the previous saved-trip route context
keeping current tour after pending adjustment clears the unapplied extension
